purpose: Document first-party Yavatmal/Maharashtra registry discovery, public route attempts, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Official Yavatmal District Administration and Maharashtra Land Records pages establish local land-record service custody. Maharashtra Bhu-Naksha is the relevant official map route. No safe anonymous ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official district land-record page naming the District Collector Office in Yavatmal and by the Maharashtra Land Records department contact page identifying the Yavatmal Deputy Superintendent and District Superintendent of Land Records offices. This is local service custody evidence only; it is not source integration, ownership evidence, or proof of citywide parcel availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Yavatmal district page labels Land Records and Village Form 7/12, places the service at the District Collector Office in Yavatmal, and links Mahabhulekh.
Official Maharashtra Land Records contact page lists the Yavatmal Deputy Superintendent of Land Records office and the District Superintendent of Land Records office.

Official Maharashtra Land Records page describes Bhu-Naksha as the route for survey-number maps and describes GIS-based land-record mapping; it is departmental information, not a verified feature response.
Official Maharashtra Bhu-Naksha viewer route exposes state/district/taluka/village and plot-number concepts in indexed viewer content; direct bounded retrieval from this environment timed out.
Official Maharashtra portal identifies Mahabhunakasha as Maps with Land Records and is managed by the Revenue Department, Government of Maharashtra.
